description: This file defines the ClientConnectionOptions class, which provides configuration options for client connections in the Orleans framework. It includes methods to add configuration delegates and to apply these configurations to connection builders.

classes.name: ClientConnectionOptions
classes.description: A class that encapsulates configuration options for client connections, allowing addition of configuration delegates and applying them to connection builders.

methods.name: ConfigureConnection
methods.description: Adds a connection configuration delegate to the options.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Applies the stored configuration delegates to a given connection builder.
